title: Australian Chillied Fish Bake
description: A spicy, comforting Australian dish featuring dried red chillies, served with a glassy-jelly like sauce.
instructions: Season the snapper fillets with lemon myrtle and lemon juice.
Heat olive oil in a hot skillet over high heat. Sear snapper for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine chillies, garlic, ginger, and fish sauce in a blender. Blend until smooth.
Strain the chilli sauce through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl, pressing on solids to extract liquid.
Add the brine and water to the bowl, whisking until combined.
Remove the skillet from the oven and place the snapper on a salt block.
Pour the chilli sauce over the snapper, then return to oven and bake for an additional 4 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
